name: @sharedid-edge/aws-lambda
description: Run SharedID Edge on AWS Lambda behind CloudFront (function URL or HTTP API, payload format 2.0), or at CloudFront's edge with Lambda@Edge

sharedidEdge.summary: A Lambda function behind a `/_sid/*` behaviour of your site's CloudFront distribution, or Lambda@Edge on that behaviour, at CloudFront's edge.

dataUpdates.how: Lambda behind CloudFront: a separate update function on an EventBridge schedule writes private S3 snapshots, and your request function's entry point loads them. Not Lambda@Edge (no environment or secrets; its settings are baked into the bundle), which keeps the data compiled into it.
